ss-delta 0.4.2 unlocks the rest of the add-ons ([#11](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/issues/11)): the raiments, hoods and sigil PSN gave as gifts, and the two raiments only Japan had. It also takes packaged mods, such as one you can make with the original *Soul Sacrifice*'s ARKS Armor and Dragonslayer, and works with the Undub alongside them. See them all in the [gallery](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/GALLERY.md).

## Downloads

| System | Download | Start |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11, x64 | `ss-delta-v0.4.2-windows.zip` | `ss-delta.exe` |
| Linux x64, Steam Deck | `ss-delta-v0.4.2-linux.tar.gz` | `ss-delta.x86_64` |
| macOS 13.3+ on Apple Silicon | `ss-delta-v0.4.2-macos.tar.gz` | `Soul Sacrifice Delta.app` |
| Android 9+, 64-bit ARM with Vulkan | `ss-delta-v0.4.2-android.apk` | **ss-delta** (install the APK) |

On a PC, unpack the archive and start the game. The first time, its importer asks for your own dump of Soul Sacrifice Delta (US PCSA00152 or EU PCSF00532, update 1.30), downloads the PS Vita firmware from Sony and a compiler, and builds the game on your computer in a few minutes. From then on the program goes straight to the game. Nothing of the game is in these downloads. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md).

macOS: the app isn't signed by a registered Apple developer, so macOS refuses it the first time. Open System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click "Open Anyway".

## New

* **The PSN gifts.** On the Vita these came from the Claim Gift page at Cassus, which needed PSN, so offline they couldn't be had. Now they appear in your save, marked NEW, the first time you load it with Add-ons (DLC) on (the default): the Soulbinder, Fox, Slave, Great Seer, Mad Witch, Easterner, Disciple, Beast and White Cat raiments, eight hoods (Fox Hood, Demon's Horns, Golden Mask, Mind's Eyewear, Wizard's Hat, Magic Helm, Polytan Hood, Possessed Mask) and the Fox Sigil. Three have another name in the game than the gift had: Necky is Fox, Archsorcerer is Great Seer, Saint is Disciple. Mad Witch and White Cat are for female sorcerers only, Great Seer for male ones.
* **The raiments only Japan had**: Sylvan and Benkei. Their data is in every version of the game; they come with **Japan-only raiments** on the settings menu's Game page (`[game] japan_raiments`, on by default).
* **Packaged mods.** A `.zip` with an `ss-delta-mod.json` inside is added like any mod, as it is, without unpacking it: the importer (`--install`) or `--dump` on a PC, **Add an add-on** on Android, the Add-ons step in RecompLauncher. Instead of replacing one of the game's archives, ss-delta merges it into the archive the game reads, so it works together with rePatch mods such as the Undub, installed before or after it. `--remove-mod <id>` takes one out again.
* **The original game's raiments.** The first *Soul Sacrifice* had two collaboration raiments Delta never got: ARKS Armor (*Phantasy Star Online 2*) and Dragonslayer (*Ragnarok Odyssey ACE*). If you have the original game with update 1.30, `tools/og-raiments.py` in the repository makes a packaged mod with them from your own copy (1.4 MB) and installs it. Wear one as both top and bottom (Triangle, "Match with Above", in the bottom list). Nothing of either game is in ss-delta ([INSTALLING](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md#what-you-need)).
* **The logs of the last five runs are kept**: `ss-delta/vita3k.log` is the latest, `vita3k.1.log` to `vita3k.4.log` the runs before it, so a report sent after starting the game again still has the run that went wrong.

## Upgrading from 0.4.x

Unpack 0.4.2 over your game's folder (replace the files) and start it, or update through RecompLauncher, which then builds the game again from your dump. On Android, install the new APK over the old one: it builds the game's code again by itself, without the dump. Saves and settings are kept. Load your save once with Add-ons (DLC) on and the gifts are in it; the game keeps them once it saves. Coming from 0.3 or older, see [Updating](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/docs/INSTALLING.md#updating).

Every release's changes: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/vita-recomps/ss-delta/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

SHA-256 and build attestations: see the files attached, and `gh attestation verify`.
